card.title: How to fix iPhone 13 to 16 pro max Face ID

source.title: How to fix iPhone 13 to 16 pro max Face ID

claims.statement: On iPhone 13–16, a TrueDepth module shorted by liquid or careless handling during other repairs can disable Face ID; the JC programmer reports the module as FUSED.

Face ID can be restored without removing the dot projector by backing up the module data with JC Repair Assistant, writing it to a JC non-removal tag-on flex, and attaching that flex; the module then reads NORMAL.

procedure: Confirm the Face ID error and repair/liquid history.
Remove the TrueDepth module; boot phone and connect to PC with JC Repair Assistant and a V1S Pro / V1SE.
Cloud-backup module data; test and confirm FUSED; Activate.
Write the Face ID data to the matching tag-on flex; verify it.
Attach the tag-on flex, confirm NORMAL, fold per model, reinstall, enroll Face ID.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
